title: Don't Say "I Don't Know" – Say This Instead #shorts
description:
Don't say "I don't know". Say this instead:
• No idea. (casual)
• I'm not sure. (polite)
• Beats me. (very casual)
• I haven't got a clue. (informal)
• Let me check. (at work)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
